notes.sessionUnknown: The band cannot tell whether the market is open, so the requirement counts as closed and borrowing stops at the price above.
notes.halted: {asset} is halted and counts for nothing.
notes.poolUnread: {asset}'s pool is absent or unread, so its liquidation is charged at the governed depth.
notes.viaBaskets: Holds {tokens} {asset} through baskets, counted as the tokens they redeem for.
notes.closureRules: From the close before a weekend or holiday to the regular open after it, and while the session is unknown, a position is liquidated only if it falls short at both edges of its bands, at most a tenth of each holding an hour, and a purchase repays at most half of what it owes above 2,000 USDG. From the 24/5 reopen, a position short at its low edges may be enrolled in the reopening auction and sold at its clearing price at the regular open, with no such half, up to what repays it.
notes.weekendPlan: To stay within 5× at the close, add {add} of equity or reduce the exposure by {reduce}.
notes.borrowPaused: The guardian has paused new loans and withdrawals from positions in debt. Deposits and repayments stay open.
notes.premium: While the market is closed, {rate, number}% a year is added on top of interest: this loan would owe {owed} USDG over a 48-hour closure. A repayment pays the debt first, then the premium.
notes.caps: All loans together owe {debt} of their {cap} USDG cap.
notes.capsUntilReopen: All loans together owe {debt} of their {cap} USDG cap; until the reopen, new loans stop at {weekendCap}.
notes.wrapsEther: Your wallet wraps the ether into WETH for your account and pays that gas; the deposit follows.
notes.signsPermit: Your wallet signs a permit for free and Tapehouse pays the gas.
notes.writeDown: A write-down by the issuer is pending: the accounts hold {balance} of the {quantity} {asset} they count.
notes.issuerBlockedYou: The issuer has blocked your address from moving {asset}.
notes.issuerBlockedAccounts: The issuer has blocked the accounts from moving {asset}.

positions.recallNote: What the vault holds free comes back at once; the rest waits at the end of its queue, returned within a day or bought in after it. You may hold {max} recalls open at once; you have {owned}.
positions.dust: A recall must queue at least a hundredth of a token.
positions.recallsFull: You have {max} recalls of {asset} open, the most an owner may.
positions.lentWarning: If this position falls short, anyone may recall all it lent through the liquidator.
